If we move departure one day earlier to Friday the eleventh of December, Turkish Airlines with one stop in Istanbul comes down to around one thousand seven hundred and fifty dirhams per adult and one thousand four hundred and twenty per child, including a twenty-three kilo checked bag. There is also Gulf Air via Bahrain at around one thousand six hundred and ninety dirhams per adult, though that fare is hand luggage only with no checked bag included. Both are the fares showing right now, confirmed at booking — which of those two works better for you?
